personal.about:
I am a Computer Science Engineering student at SRM Institute of Science and Technology with a strong passion for Full Stack Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Software Engineering.

I enjoy building scalable web applications, solving challenging problems, and learning modern technologies. My experience includes developing full-stack MERN applications, AI-powered solutions, REST APIs, and responsive web interfaces.

I have completed dual internship from Soft Nexis and CodeMore Technology.

I also have industry certifications from organizations such as Deloitte, Gemini, ServiceNow University, IBM SkillsBuild, and Oracle. Through these experiences, I have strengthened my skills in frontend development, backend engineering, databases, authentication, API integration, and machine learning.

My goal is to become a skilled software engineer capable of building impactful products that improve people's lives through technology.

experience.description:
• Built RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express.js with 5+ secure endpoints for task management.
• Integrated MongoDB Atlas using Mongoose for cloud-based data storage and retrieval.
Improved application security Rate Limiting, reducing brute-force vulnerability risks by 90%.
Connected responsive frontend components with backend APIs and tested complete CRUD operations.

Developed 3 full-stack web applications, including a task management system and portfolio platform using the MERN stack. Built RESTful APIs with authentication, role-based access control (Admin/User), and input validation for secure client server communication. Implemented password hashing, API rate limiting, and protected routes to improve application security and prevent unauthorized access.
